description: This PHP file defines a class EmployeeWorkShiftModel within the OrangeHRM project. The class models an employee's work shift with start and end times, implementing serialization and conversion to array functionality. It utilizes traits and other data transfer objects, serving as part of the API layer for employee work shift data.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkShiftModel
classes.description: A model representing an employee's work shift with start and end times, designed for API serialization and data transfer within the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the work shift start and end time object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the employee work shift data to an associative array with formatted start and end times.
